content_data.meeting_title: Strategic AI Integration Roadmap for European Media Expansion
agenda_items: Review of current AI content generation pipeline performance in pilot markets

key_decisions: Initiate a strategic partnership exploration with a leading European data analytics firm to enhance audience segmentation capabilities.
attendees: Isabelle Dubois, Head of European Operations
Dr. Anya Sharma, Head of AI Research
Sofia Rodriguez, VP of Business Development
